title: Quinoa and Almond Stuffed Capsicums
subtitle: with Cheddar
description: Super-charged with quinoa, spinach and toasty almonds, these stuffed capsicum boats are everything you want in a veggie-based dinner, and then some.

steps.text: Cook quinoa: Preheat the oven to 200C. Rinse half the quinoa well in a sieve, then drain. Put in a small saucepan with 125ml (½ cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 12-15 mins until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is tender. Turn off the heat, add half the spinach leaves and stand, covered, for 5 mins (see Make it yours).

Roast capsicums: Meanwhile, line an oven tray with foil. Halve the capsicums lengthwise, put on the lined tray and brush with 1 tbs olive oil. Put the almonds on another oven tray. Cook the capsicums on an upper oven shelf for 8 mins, then add the almonds to a lower shelf and cook for a further 3 mins or until the capsicums are soft and the almonds are golden.

Make dressing: Coarsely grate the zucchini, then squeeze out the excess liquid with your hands. Coarsely grate the cheese. Crush 2 garlic cloves. Put 1 tbs olive oil, 1 tbs white wine vinegar and 1 tsp honey in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Turn the oven to grill mode and preheat to medium-high.

Stuff capsicums: Put the quinoa mixture, almonds, garlic, three-quarters of the zucchini, half the grated cheese and half the dressing in a bowl, season well with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Spoon into the capsicum boats, pressing down to compact. Scatter over the remaining cheese.

Grill and serve up: Grill the stuffed capsicums for 5 mins or until the cheese is melted and golden. Meanwhile, add the remaining spinach and zucchini to the dressing, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Divide the stuffed capsicums and spinach salad among plates and enjoy.
Make it yours: Add an extra level of flavour by stirring a little smoked paprika through the quinoa mixture.
